module: Generated LuaJIT file (jit.vmdef, "DO NOT EDIT"): tables of names used by the jit.* tools (dump, bc, v, profiler) to display bytecodes, IR instructions, fast functions, IR C calls and trace failure reasons. It returns a data table; only useful for debugging or analyzing the JIT.

bcnames.desc: Names of the LuaJIT bytecode opcodes concatenated, 6 characters per opcode (padded with spaces).

irnames.desc: Names of the trace compiler's IR operations, concatenated in blocks of 6 characters.

irfpm.desc: Names of the IR's FPMATH math functions (floor, ceil, trunc, sqrt, exp, exp2, log, log2, log10, sin, cos, tan, other), 0-based.

irfield.desc: Names of the object fields accessible by the IR (str.len, func.env, tab.meta, tab.array...), 0-based.

ircall.desc: Names of the C functions called by the IR (lj_str_cmp, lj_tab_new1, sqrt...), 0-based.

traceerr.desc: Trace recording error messages (e.g. "trace too short", "trace too long"), 0-based.
